documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended 30Th June, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Pasupati Acrylon reported an increase in operational revenue to Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh and profit after tax to Rs. 3,538.12 Lakh for the financial year 2024-25. Management highlighted the successful commissioning of its 150 KL per day grain-based ethanol plant in March 2025. The company continues to monitor global risks including crude oil volatility, foreign exchange fluctuations, and geopolitical tensions.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve better exports in the coming years.
guidance.quote: The Company has exported to Dubai, Peru, Thailand, Morrocco, Tunisia, Nepal, Ukraine, Turkey, Algeria, Kenya, Brazil, Poland, Lebanon etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates sustained demand growth across segments.
guidance.quote: Your Company anticipates sustained demand growth across segments.

guidance.claim: The performance of the CPP films division is expected to improve in the coming years.
guidance.quote: During the year, the performance was marginally improved due to better sentiments in the market and it is expected to improve in the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 4.2% CAGR till 2035.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 4.2% CAGR till 2035.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 4.2% CAGR till 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 4.2% CAGR till 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.
demand_outlook.quote: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to account for a substantial share of the global acrylic fibre market.
demand_outlook.quote: According to Future Market Insights (FMI), India is expected to account for a substantial share of the global acrylic fibre market, owing to the rapid expansion of the textiles industry and the rise in the export of yarns and fibres.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for packaged foods is at an all-time high due to growing world population.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for packaged foods is at an all-time high due to growing world population.

demand_outlook.claim: Considering the ethanol demand-supply gap, the ethanol market is anticipated to grow in the future.
demand_outlook.quote: Considering the above gap, the ethanol market is anticipated to grow in the future.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years due to macroeconomic developments in end-use sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years, particularly due to the macroeconomic development of end-use sectors which is supported by regional GDP and population growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The CPP films industry is projected to expand at a robust rate with rising packaging requirements across sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rising requirement for packaging across sectors, with traditional businesses preferring to package products, and the retail and e-commerce growing rapidly, the CPP films industry is projected to expand at a robust rate.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for acrylic fibre has risen, leading to increased production and sales compared to the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand of Acrylic Fibre has risen and the Company’s production and sales of Acrylic Fibre was 36,425 MT and 35,260 MT respectively as compared to production of 29,652 MT and sales of 30,918 MT during the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: The global CPP film market is anticipated to rise at a considerable rate between 2022 and 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: The global CPP Film Market is anticipated to rise at a considerable rate during the forecast period, between 2022 and 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: The CPP film market is highly competitive due to the presence of multiple vendors.
demand_outlook.quote: The CPP Film Market is highly competitive owing to the presence of multiple vendors in the market.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based ethanol plant and commenced commercial production in March 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost of the ethanol plant was assessed at Rs. 167 Crore, but the company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost was assessed Rs. 167 Crore (excluding working capital margin) but the project was overrun due to Civil work. Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: A solar power system of 750 KW has been installed.
capex_expansion.quote: Solar Power System of 750 KW has been installed.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company has already initiated steps to establish a grain-based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the ethanol project is Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Indian Bank had sanctioned a Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores for the ethanol project.
capex_expansion.quote: Indian Bank had sanctioned Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores and as per stipulations of sanction letter, the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 would be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far on the ethanol project.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the Company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far which includes Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board of Directors approved setting up an ethanol project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD at a total project cost of Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 18, 2022, accorded its approval to the Company to set-up Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD to align with GOI’s Ethanol Blending Programme (E20), subject to clearance and approvals from the concerned statutory authorities. The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Loss in the CPP segment declined due to better realization and reduction in overheads.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, loss of CPP has been declined due to better realization and reduction in overheads.

margins_costs.claim: Various cost optimizations via alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements, and operational efficiency led to significant savings.
margins_costs.quote: Various cost optimisation driven by way of alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements and operational efficiency improvements has led significant savings.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue and net profit declined due to lower demand and negative returns on the CPP segment caused by excessive production capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue and Net profit during the year declined due to lower demand of acrylic fibre and negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

margins_costs.claim: Global acrylic fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.
margins_costs.quote: Global Acrylic Fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.

margins_costs.claim: Loss of the CPP segment was incurred due to persistent fall in selling prices from excessive market capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Loss of CPP segment is incurred during the year caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

margins_costs.claim: Net profit declined during the year due to negative returns on the CPP segment caused by a persistent fall in selling prices from excessive market production capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Net profit during the year declined due to negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

margins_costs.claim: Operating profit margin, net profit margin, and return on net worth declined due to negative returns on the CPP segment.
margins_costs.quote: *Operating Profit Margin, Net Profit Margin and Return on Net Worth are declined due to negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The production capacity to produce acrylic products of the company is 42,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the company recorded acrylic fibre production of 35,198 MT and sales of 33,850 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's production capacity to produce CPP film is 10,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, production and sale of CPP film was 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively as against production of 6,463 MT and sale of 6,476 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, production and sale of ethanol was 790 KL and 440 KL respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of Ethanol was 790 KL and 440 KL respectively.

orders_capacity.claim: The Company recorded a production of 31,534 MT and sales of 31,685 MT for acrylic fibre during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT, as against production of 36,425 MT and Sale of 35,260 MT respectively during the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: During the year under review, the board of directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has neither accepted nor renewed any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, your Company has neither accepted nor renewed any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24 as internal accruals are utilized to set up the ethanol plant.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company’s internal accruals is being utilized to set-up Ethanol Plant, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided to plough back earnings and not recommend a dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors decided to plough back the earnings to strengthen the financials of the Company and not to recommend dividend for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 crores for the ethanol project will be met out of the company's internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 will be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Crude prices remained volatile due to conflicts including the Israel-Hamas war and Russia-Ukraine war.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Since the company is dependent upon imports, fluctuations in foreign exchange rates (USD vs INR) bear an impact on margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies, and the company has no control over them.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies (“OMC”) and the Company has no control on the prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Company faced challenges from the dumping of acrylic fibre by China, Thailand and Belarus.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite various challenges such as volatility in crude prices and raw material prices, dumping of acrylic fibre by China, Thailand and Belarus, foreign exchange fluctuations, the Company is focused on improvement in its revenue and net profit.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geo-political tensions, subdued global conditions, intense competition, and regulatory changes are key risks exposing the company to uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geo-political tensions including supply chain disruption, subdued global economic conditions, changes in government policies and trade sanctions and restrictions, intense competition from local and global players, regulatory changes and cyber security threats are key risks which expose the Company to potential challenges and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced various challenges such as volatility in crude prices, abnormal rise in raw material prices, dumping of acrylic fibre by multiple countries, and foreign exchange fluctuations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite various challenges such as volatility in crude prices and abnormal rise in raw material prices, dumping of acrylic fibre by Turkey, China, Thailand and Belarus, foreign exchange fluctuations, the Company is focused on improvement in its growth and in a position to achieve a better turnover as compared to previous year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The risk from the COVID-19 pandemic continues to be one of the key business risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though COVID-19 related concerns have been subsided in the world, but the risk from the COVID-19 pandemic continues to be one of the key business risks.

management_commitments.claim: The company entered into long-term contracts with suppliers in the films division to mitigate crude-derived raw material price fluctuations.
management_commitments.quote: To mitigate the effect, the Company has entered into long term contracts with suppliers in films division.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commence commercial production of ethanol by September, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

management_commitments.claim: The company is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and is hopeful of achieving better exports.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has exported to Dubai, Egypt, Peru, Ukraine, Turkey, Algeria, Kenya, Nigeria, Brazil, Lebanon etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports this year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
